versions.changelog:
Initial release of the diagnose-scheduled-job-trigger-vs-execution-failure skill.

- Provides structured steps to diagnose "scheduled job not executed" issues, distinguishing between trigger failures and execution failures.
- Includes evidence-based methods to prove the root cause, with sample log entries and error codes for reference.
- Offers clear templates for incident conclusions and recovery verification.
- Lists common pitfalls and corresponding best practices for troubleshooting scheduled jobs.
- Supports post-repair regression validation of diverse task types to ensure full recovery.
- Aimed at ensuring incidents are precisely classified and backed by operational evidence, especially in complex OAuth/workspace authorization environments.
